analysis.title: Senior DataCenter Provisioning Engineer
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong infrastructure capacity planning, performance engineering, and Python automation skills, but the role is focused on hands-on data center provisioning (network devices, servers, BGP, CDN internals) which is not the candidate's core professional experience. The candidate's background is more in capacity forecasting, APM, and data engineering, with some AWS and Linux exposure, but lacks direct evidence of provisioning, routing, or CDN operations. The score reflects partial alignment on automation and infrastructure scale, but significant gaps in the core provisioning domain.
strengths: Strong capacity planning and forecasting (CITI, HorizonScale)
Experience with large-scale infrastructure (6,000+ endpoints, 200+ MySQL nodes)
Linux environment comfort and scripting (Bash, Python)
Automation and tooling experience (Git, Ansible, Chef mentioned in job; candidate has Git, Python, PowerShell)
AWS experience (S3, Glue, Athena) and cloud migration support
gaps: No direct experience with network device provisioning, BGP, or IP routing
No CDN or edge cloud platform experience
No hands-on server provisioning or rack/stack operations
Limited exposure to Ansible/Chef in production (not listed in profile)
No evidence of working with network operations or POP buildouts
Role requires deep TCP/IP and client/server dataflow understanding; candidate's background is more application/performance focused
tailoring_plan: 1. Highlight any Linux system administration and scripting experience (even if from personal projects or AWS work). 2. Emphasize Python automation for infrastructure tasks (e.g., ETL, telemetry, monitoring integration). 3. Frame capacity forecasting as a form of provisioning capacity planning. 4. Mention any experience with network monitoring or performance tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics) as related to network health. 5.
